About Scholora

Built for students who want more than a passing grade.

Scholora started as a small classroom of nine students and three subjects. Today it's a full academy, but the promise hasn't changed: no student moves on to a new topic until the last one has actually clicked.

We keep class sizes small, track progress subject by subject, and treat parents as partners rather than spectators. Whether a student is just starting out or preparing for board exams, our job is to close the exact gap that's holding them back.

Our mission

Make expert, personal teaching accessible to every student, at every level.

Our vision

A community where curiosity is rewarded and no question is too basic to ask.

Our story

Founded by teachers who were tired of watching bright students fall through the cracks of large classrooms.
